title: GPT-5 just leaked and it's terrifying

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What does GPT-5's leak reveal about the pace and power of AI advancement?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: GPT-5's leaked models show unprecedented reasoning, code generation, and multilingual fluency—far beyond current benchmarks.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: The real terror is how easily such power could be weaponized for deepfakes, manipulation, and erosion of trust in institutions.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are embedding watermarking, alignment checks, and access controls to prevent misuse and ensure transparency.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If responsibly governed, GPT-5 could democratize access to knowledge and creativity for billions of people.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future hinges on whether we build guardrails as fast as we build power.

video_cue: A split-screen showing a secure server room and a bustling global city with AI-assisted services.
